statement: The rule register leaves report mode (rules.check_mode refuse) once every stopping rule of the catalog is justified by a decision, so a refusal with no rule stops the change that adds it.
note: rules.check_mode has been report since 28/10 (RULE-AUDIT) with no deadline; the catalog now holds every refusal (PADRAO-DEV F1b). Rejected by D-328 (18/11): the refuse mode, refusals() and STD-rule-registry-refusals left, and the standard's catalog of rules (D-317) is the one register.
